interpretation: Baseline symlink returned synthetic canary data; baseline FIFO blocked until owned child was killed/reaped. Candidate rejects both with empty output. The50ms native command deadline is not a documented filesystem deadline; special-file rejection removes this specific blocking path,not general filesystem stalls.

Two matched runs show cache-listener acknowledgement median overhead about0.8–1.0%for8-byte records and1.4–2.1%for8192-byte records. Accept security cost; no runtime speedup,syscall-only,cold,RSS/allocation or Linux/Windows timing claim.

Final minimal-diff harness matches the first formatted matched harness after excluding argparse help text from parsed AST comparison; formatting/help wording do not change measured code. Earlier separate-cwd/environment explorations remain in private session evidence and are not used as identical-environment comparisons.
Real CLI regressions require failure,empty output,no native launch and no later save. Existing baseline cache bytes and key identities remain usable; no release/install binaries were changed.
Remaining trust: parent paths and same-user writers. No full ancestor pinning,cache authentication,Unix extended ACL inspection,Windows cache owner-only ACL enforcement or command sandbox.
